## Summary
The C0/Stage-1 measurement/Lab schema slices land: the benchmark and
environment records, the canonical assumption-debt vocabulary with typed
removal tests and per-home validation, the snapshot/compatibility claims,
the experiment spec/plan schemas with deterministic ids and the closed
refusal set, the analysis records, and the results-row-key manifest
fields — as schemas, codecs, deterministic identities and pure validation,
ahead of the Stage-3 engines (ADR-0209 D2).

### `hh-lab` (new persistent crate — the Lab schema plane)
- **`bench.rs`** — `TaskRecord` (disjoint `visible`/`held_out`/`instrument`;
  `task_id` = semantic-projection id excluding `foreign`,
  `instrument.validity`/`contamination`, `provenance`), `SuiteManifest`,
  `SuiteValidityRecord`, `SplitAssignmentRecord` (`suite_id`/`split_hash`
  derived over canonical bytes), the L1 import-side `HeldOutInEnvironment`
  check (`HeldOutLeak` stays the delivery predicate in hh-verification),
  contamination strata, `verifier_isolation` default rule.
- **`model.rs`** — `ForeignRef{system, digest, label?, provenance}` (a
  claim, never a `ContentAddress` — I-2); `SnapshotClaim` (additive on
  `ModelDiscoveryClaim`: lineage, `trained_under[]`, `weights_digest`,
  `training_cutoff_claim{value?, provenance}`, `policy_version_exposed`);
  `CompatibilityRecord` (`subject_kind: snapshot_pair`, status 5-sum).
- **`experiment.rs`** — `ExperimentSpec` (`hh-experiment/1`, kind 5-sum,
  factors/levels/arms, suite binding, seed/scheduling/reattempt/budgets),
  `CellPlan`/`RunPlan`/`OrderPlan`, the closed 15-code `RegisterRefusal`
  sum checked against `SpecContext`, `experiment_id = H(canonical(spec))`,
  `run_plan_id = H(experiment_id ∥ arm_id ∥ configuration_version_id ∥
  task_id ∥ replicate_index)` (scheduling fields excluded).
- **`analysis.rs`** — `AnalysisSpec`/`AnalysisReport`/`QuerySpec`/
  `watermark_set`/`Cell`/`ResamplePlan`/`AnalysisRecord`/`RenderSpec`,
  the full `ComparisonReport` shape (`budget_match.status` 3-sum,
  `benefit_kind`, `paired_effect`, `outcome_bounds`, `multiplicity`,
  `label`), `FittedSurfaceReport.debt_record_ref`.
- **`debt.rs`** — the derived `DebtIndexRow`/`DebtReport`/`DebtNotice`/
  `AssumptionDebtHealth` views (projections, never sources of truth).

### Debt plane (R-2.9.6⁰ᵃ)
- **`hh-ontology::debt`** (new) — the one canonical vocabulary (CC1/CC7):
  `DebtStatus{active, expiring, expired, retired}`, `ExpiryKind`,
  `ExpiryCondition{kind, value?}`, `DebtClass`, `DeficiencyClass` 12-sum,
  `EvidenceKind`/`EvidenceRef`, derived `EvidenceGrade`,
  `HypothesisTyped`, `DebtScope`/`ModelSelector`, `RemovalTest` 12-kind
  closed sum, `RemovalVerdict`, `OwnerRef`, `DebtHome`/`DEBT_HOMES` (the
  closed 17-home inventory), `DebtPolicy` (full member set; defaults are
  declared ADR-0214 placeholders). `hh-compiler::profile` re-exports;
  the interim `hh_hir::DebtStatus` is replaced. Legacy spellings decode:
  `open → active`, `discharged → retired`, `violated → expired`; bare
  expiry strings decode as `{kind}` (CC8).
- **`AssumptionDebtRecord/1`** — additive on the /0 ratified form:
  `debt_class`, `hypothesis_typed`, `scope`, `expiry`, `runway_ms`,
  `revalidation`, `removal_test`, `created_by`, `created_at`, `supersedes`
  added optional; `removal_test_ref` stays ratified.
- **`hh-hir::debt`** (new) — `validate_removal_test`/`validate_for_home`:
  member-level checks always (beneficiaries ⊆ scope, mandatory payloads,
  `InsufficientRunway`, `OwnerUnreachable`), resolver-parameterized
  checks (`UnresolvedTemplate`, `MissingMatchSpec`, `NotARetirementDiff`,
  `UnresolvedProbeRef`, `UnresolvedZeroUseScope`,
  `MissingSplitAssignment`, `UnsealedArtifact`) when the caller supplies
  resolvers. HIR `validate`/`seal` run the member-level half →
  `HirError::RemovalTestRefusal` (mirrored `C-KERN-*` in hh-assembly);
  `harness_rule.assumption_debt` is model-scoped → requires `debt_class` +
  instantiated `removal_test` + `scope.model_selectors`; unlisted kinds ⇒
  `UnknownDebtHome`.
- **`hh-compiler::link`** — `lcd_report.conditioned_rules[]` gains
  `evidence_grade` + `removal_test_executable`.
- **Ledger** — `lifecycle.debt.{status.changed, removal_test.scheduled,
  removal_test.settled, expired_used}` declared audit-grade/
  provenance-mandatory.

### Row keys + classes (R-2.10.5⁰ fields)
- `RunManifest.experiment: Option<ExperimentBinding>` — experiment runs
  bind `{experiment_id, plan_id, …}` (pinned); `agent` subject runs carry
  the all-or-nothing `{experiment_run_id, arm_id, cell_id, design_ref?,
  pre_registration_ref?, replicate_index, attempt_no, comparable}` row
  key; other kinds never carry the member (`RunManifest::validate`).
- `measurement.experiment.*` (16) / `measurement.analysis.*` (2) /
  `measurement.leaderboard.*` (2) classes declared in `CLASS_TABLE`.
- `hh-identity` `RecordKind`s for the new record types;
  `hh-ontology::eval::EstimatorSelection` additive bump
  (`floors`/`fallback_chain`/`substituted?` — old `{method}` bodies
  decode); `TaskRef.split_label: SplitLabel`.

### DF-S1.22-3 closed
`MetricDeclaration.applies_to_families` is the typed
`BTreeSet<EnvironmentFamily>`; `RegistryRecord::EnvironmentFamily` +
`resolve_environment_family` land so a family-scoped metric resolves
against a registered `environment_family` record — old name-spelling
bodies still decode (CC8).

## Deferrals
Closed: **DF-S1.22-3** — the `environment_family` record kind landed;
`applies_to_families` typed; family-scoped metrics resolve against
registered records.
Opened: **DF-S1.24-1** (the Stage-3+ executable halves — engine ops,
estimators, results store, debt manager + `lifecycle.debt.*` emitters,
resolver-backed removal-test checks, L2 runtime enforcement, claim
consumers) · **DF-S1.24-2** (the Stage-3 executable acceptance battery
over the reference suite) · **DF-S1.24-3** (`ModelProfile/1`'s
`debt.hypothesis` string vs the HIR `Text` leaf — unify at
`ModelProfile/2`).

## Decisions
**ADR-0260** — `hh-lab` as the Lab schema plane; the canonical debt
vocabulary in `hh-ontology::debt` (legacy decode mappings);
`AssumptionDebtRecord/1` additive + `DebtHomes/1` per-home required
fields; member-level vs resolver-backed `validate_removal_test` split
(`RemovalTestRefusal` at seal/register); `ForeignRef` a claim never a
`ContentAddress`; deterministic ids (`experiment_id`/`run_plan_id`/
`suite_id`/`split_hash`/`task_id`); `DebtPolicy` placeholder defaults per
ADR-0214; the manifest `experiment` member as the row-key source;
DF-S1.22-3 closure.
